# unifi_access_holiday_group (Resource)

A UniFi Access holiday group — a named set of holidays used to scope unlock schedules. Managed over the private Access API (`/proxy/access/api/v2/holiday_group`). Membership is the set of holiday `unique_id`s in `holiday_ids`; the holidays themselves are not modeled by this resource. **Modeled from the reverse-engineered Access API and not yet verified against a live console — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Holiday group display name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Holiday group description.
- `holiday_ids` (Set of String) Member holiday ids (`unique_id` of each holiday). Reconciled from the group's holiday list on refresh.
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether the group is private to its creator.
- `template_name` (String) Template the group was seeded from, if any.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Creation timestamp, RFC3339 (read-only).
- `holiday_count` (Number) Number of member holidays (read-only).
- `id` (String) Access object id (`unique_id`). Import key.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default holiday group (read-only).
